description: Monthly loan payment plus running costs (insurance, fuel, and maintenance, given as annual amounts), total interest, and the five year cost of a car. Use when the user asks what car payment fits their budget including insurance, fuel and maintenance. For loan figures on a specific car use calculate_auto_loan. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive car affordability calculator.

fuel_annual.description: Fuel cost per year in USD; default 0.

insurance_annual.description: Insurance cost per year in USD; default 0.

maintenance_annual.description: Maintenance cost per year in USD; default 0.
